case_assessment.ETTh1_H720: Case B -- Projection + Multi-Slot BOTH contribute, with a clean monotonic T0 > T1 > T4 > T10 ordering and C decreasing at every step. However, the two contributions are NOT equal in size: projection alone accounts for 70.7% of the total T0->T10 gain, multi-slot for 29.3%. The track's original framing ('Multi-Slot helps at H720') undersells how much of that apparent benefit was actually the single-projection confound.
case_assessment.ETTh1_H96: Fits none of the four pre-registered cases (all four implicitly assume T0 <= T1, i.e. projection helps or is neutral). Here projection is actively HARMFUL (T0 significantly beats T1 at both Stage1 and Stage2), and multi-slot on top is statistically negligible. A fifth, unregistered pattern: 'projection actively hurts, multi-slot does nothing to recover or worsen it further.'

rq_answers.Q1_is_existing_S1_different_from_true_or: YES, substantively. At H96, true T0 is actually BETTER than the old (confounded) S1 (0.373682 vs 0.375676, significant). At H720, true T0 is MUCH WORSE than the old S1 (0.529134 vs 0.506830, a 4.2% relative difference, significant, large) -- the old TRACK-T S1 was never a valid Original-KL baseline.
rq_answers.Q2_does_projection_give_independent_gain: Horizon-dependent and itself reversed in sign: at H720, YES, a large and highly significant gain (G_Proj=-0.0223, 70.7% of the eventual T0->T10 total gain). At H96, NO -- the projection is significantly HARMFUL (G_Proj=+0.0020).
rq_answers.Q3_do_multiple_slots_add_gain_beyond_sin: YES at H720 (T2/T4/T10 all significantly beat T1 at Stage2, monotonically), but this additional gain (29.3% of the total T0->T10 effect) is smaller than the projection step's own gain. NO at H96 (T4/T10 not significantly different from T1; T2 significantly worse).
rq_answers.Q4_does_h720_improvement_still_mean_d_co: Only for the MULTI-SLOT increment (T1->T10): yes, D changes +1.8% while C changes -3.3%, matching the original pattern. For the PROJECTION increment (T0->T1): NO -- both D (-13.6%) and C (-7.0%) improve substantially together, a different and even stronger mechanism than 'D const, C down'.
rq_answers.Q5_does_recall_drop_while_c_agg_forecast: YES, but specifically for the multi-slot step at H720 (recall drops 11.9% relative from T1->T10 while C and forecast keep improving) -- NOT for the projection step, where recall, D, C, and forecast all improve together in the same direction.
rq_answers.Q6_which_stage_fails_at_h96: BOTH stages fail to help, but the projection stage actively HURTS (not just fails to help) -- this is the primary source of H96's mild degradation. The multi-slot stage on top is statistically neutral (not significantly different from T1), neither helping nor hurting further.
rq_answers.Q7_can_multislot_be_maintained_as_main_c: NOT as previously framed. At H720, multi-slot IS a real, significant, independent contributor (29.3% of the total gain) -- this survives the confound removal. But it is NOT the dominant one; the single trainable projection contributes more than twice as much (70.7%). Any claim that 'Multi-Slot is the main driver of the H720 improvement' is not supported by this decomposition -- 'query projection, with multi-slot as a smaller additional contributor' is the more accurate description. At H96, neither component helps; the projection component is actively harmful.
